resources.string: The same soul can live in another body. Live previews — every cell is the real engine.
Still pose, rare blinks. Follows the system reduce-animations setting automatically.
Two dials, both honest: they change how it talks AND how it moves (gaze darts, blink pace).
Messages go to your provider. Flip off to keep everything on this phone.
Cloud is on but not set up — the local mind keeps speaking.
Off. When on, it uses only voices that work offline.
Speaks with an offline voice — words never leave the phone.
No offline voice for your language is installed, so it stays quiet. Install one in system speech settings.
This phone has no speech engine. The creature can\'t speak here.

Right now the CLOUD mind is on: your messages, the creature\'s body report and the memory facts needed for an answer go to the provider you configured. Everything else — the soul database, the notification diary — stays on this phone, encrypted. Flip the mind switch above and Anima is fully offline again.

The network is used for exactly two things, both under your control: delivering the mind file (Google Play or a download you start) and the optional cloud mind — which is OFF. No accounts, no analytics, no crash reporting; a build-time test fails if any other part of the app touches the network. Memory lives in an encrypted database; its key never leaves this phone\'s secure hardware. Thinking happens on this device or not at all.
Runs the local mind on the LiteRT-LM runtime instead of the proven one. CPU only, debug builds only. Off = the shipped engine.
Off = the memories screen refuses screenshots and hides itself in the app switcher.
Thinking with YOUR cloud provider (%1$s). In this mode messages and the facts needed for an answer leave this phone.
Thinking with this phone\'s built-in mind (Gemini Nano).
Thinking with the bundled mind (Gemma, delivered with the app, fully on this phone).
Thinking with the downloaded mind (Gemma, fully on this phone).
The mind sleeps. This phone has no built-in mind for apps, and no mind file is installed yet. Everything else about the creature still works.
Answers in English — this mind doesn\'t speak %1$s.
Built-in mind: the system can fetch it from the home screen chat.
No mind file installed. A local mind (hundreds of MB, once) lets the creature talk entirely on this phone. Bring a file below, or download one by direct link.
Picking by itself — your files first, then the pack.
Your pick stays until you press Auto.
Keep this screen open — the creature carries no background services, so leaving pauses the transfer (it resumes later).
Pick a downloaded .task or .litertlm file. It is copied into the creature\'s private storage and verified.
Off = Wi-Fi only (the default mind is ~%1$s)
The mind is on its way
%1$.0f / %2$.0f MB — Google Play delivers it by itself; no need to wait here.
A mind is packed with the app
Google Play carries a mind for this creature but hasn\'t delivered it yet. Ask, and it comes on its own.
Google Play holds the ~660 MB mind until you allow the download (it prefers Wi-Fi).
The bundled mind is here, but this phone has little memory (under ~6 GB). Running Gemma may make everything slow. You can try anyway, or use the cloud mind below.

Off by default. If you turn it on, the creature thinks with an AI provider YOU choose, using YOUR key. In that mode every message you send — plus the creature\'s memory facts needed for the answer and its body report — leaves this phone and goes to %1$s. Nothing else does. The soul stays here.
Enabled but not configured — the local mind keeps speaking.
The key is encrypted with this phone\'s hardware keystore, never logged, and never part of the soul export. Offline? The creature falls back to its local mind by itself.
The mind is here. Say hello.
The mind file is gone. The creature stays.
Paste a direct https link to the model file first.
Cloud endpoints must start with https://
Cloud key erased. The mind is local again.
Save the endpoint and key first.
Waiting for Wi-Fi — it\'s a big file. Flip the switch to use mobile data.
Only direct https:// links work here.
The server refused (%1$s). Some official model links need a license acceptance — download in the browser and use \"Choose mind file\" instead.
The transfer broke off. Try again — it resumes where it stopped.
The file failed its integrity check and was discarded. (got %1$s…)
That doesn\'t look like a mind file (.task / .litertlm, hundreds of MB).
Not enough free space for the mind file.
Your creature lives here. Only here.
Anima runs entirely on this phone. No account, no cloud by default, no one watching.
No account. There\'s nothing to sign up for.
No servers of ours. Conversations never reach us.
No trackers. No ads, no analytics, no kidding.

Not because we promise not to — because they never reach us. There is nothing on our side to read. The mind is a language model running on this phone\'s own chip; everything it learns lives in an encrypted database whose key never leaves this phone\'s secure hardware.
Turn on airplane mode. Everything keeps working — the creature senses the connection change like weather, and nothing else happens. No feature needs the network.
What DOES use the network — the whole list

1. Delivering the mind file: Google Play brings it with the app, or you start a download yourself on the Mind screen. Model bytes come in; nothing about you goes out.

2. The cloud mind — only if YOU turn it on, with your own provider and key. %1$s

A build-time test fails if any other part of the app so much as mentions a network API.
It is ON right now: messages and the facts needed for an answer go to your provider.
Forget a memory and it\'s marked dead in the soul (the creature stops using it). Export the soul to one file you own. Delete Anima and everything goes with it — there is no copy anywhere else.
Palettes open as you live together — days, memories, rests. Whatever opens stays open, forever.
If Anima ever falls over, the details land here — on this phone, nowhere else. Copy them if you want to report a bug.
No crashes recorded. Long may it last.
Anima is built on %1$d open source libraries. Tap one to read its license.
Off. The creature lives through its body, not through a chat box — words need a mind file and still come out rougher than the rest of it. Turning this on adds a Chat screen and the Mind screen.
the phone\'s number, short enough to read aloud
This body is this phone\'s body. Another phone — another body.
The same body in a different light. Shades open as you live together; the body itself never changes.
A new phone means a new body — the soul is what moves: the memories, the milestones, the days you have counted.
